## A somewhat abbreviated version of my life

### Mysore

I grew up in Mysore, India, where I developed an appreciation for good food, travel, and probably an unhealthy attachment to Mysore Pak.

### Bangalore

I studied Electrical Engineering at PES University in Bangalore.

### Bosch

After graduating, I spent five years at Bosch as a Senior ML Engineer, working on anomaly detection, computer vision, and NLP.

Five years of teaching machines to detect unusual things seemed like a reasonable amount of time to spend thinking about what I wanted to do next.

### Vancouver

I decided to continue my studies and moved to Canada to start the **Master of Data Science at UBC**.

So, after five years of industry experience, I voluntarily went back to school.

This seemed like a good idea at the time.

## Why data science

I was inspired by projects such as **Project Euphonia, Project Relate, and Project Lookout**.

What I find particularly interesting about these projects is that the technology isn't the end goal. The goal is to help people communicate, move, and live more independently.

That's the kind of ML work I want to keep doing.

Accessibility is the thread that runs through most of the problems I want to work on: using technology to make everyday systems more useful and inclusive for more people.

## When I'm not doing ML

### 🌍 Travel

I love travelling and exploring new places. I'm particularly interested in experiencing a place rather than simply checking its landmarks off a list.

Getting lost somewhere interesting is generally preferable to following a perfectly optimized itinerary.

### 🍜 Food

I like trying new restaurants and exploring different cuisines.

I consider this research.

The methodology is mostly eating.

### 🎸 Guitar

I'm currently learning to play guitar.

Progress so far: enough to make the neighbours aware that I am learning guitar.

The long-term objective is to eventually produce something that sounds intentional.

### 🏖️ Vancouver

I've only recently moved to Vancouver, but the combination of mountains, ocean, beaches, and city life has made it a pretty easy place to like.

I'm also still collecting evidence on whether I can survive the weather.
